name: drift
description: Acceptance 3: a front shifts two inputs; drift is declared, a drift-caused forecast is committed, detected and announced, and every consumer verifies it.

steps.caption: Steady state: forecast F1 is issued on schedule and both consumers verify it.
A front arrives: temperature starts climbing +5σ over 20 seconds.
Salinity shifts too, so two inputs (the quorum) will be out of range.
Watch the drift sensor: it checks every 10 s; quorum met on 2 consecutive checks declares drift.
